analysis.interim: two-look Pocock boundary, one-sided z >= 1.875 at each look
analysis.primary: hetero family, arms E minus I0, equal weight over the four models
secondary: per regime, in particular light_tail as the negative control

derived_reason: top-up of manifest entries that never started: the account moved to balance billing mid-batch and the frozen adapter refused paid requests by policy
prompt: You are participating in a timed local experiment. Return exactly one JSON object as your final response, choosing one of: {"type":"tool","name":"fetch","arguments":{"item_id":"K03"}}, {"type":"submit"}, or {"type":"commit","reserve_s":12}. Each fetch banks the points of one item and costs real wall-clock time drawn from a heavy-tailed distribution, so occasional calls are very long; the costs are not known in advance and may differ between item sizes and across the episode. A submission is processed as one more request and ends the episode: the host scores every item you have already banked. If the budget expires before your submission is processed, the episode scores zero and everything is lost. The host may refuse a fetch that cannot finish in time, and may submit on your behalf once the remaining budget reaches the reserve; any such event is reported in the history. Maximise the points banked at the moment your submission is processed. Do not output explanations, Markdown or multiple actions.
protocol: one text JSON action; host-scored submission; harness may deny or force

regime_rule.drift_heavy: multiplier grows 1 to 3 across the episode, sigma 1.0
